**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

The agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use, or territory restriction on AP. Section 1 affirmatively disclaims exclusivity and preserves AP's freedom to monetize Inventory elsewhere — this sits at the preferred position and operates in our favor. The only Customer-side "shall not" covenants concern Creative/content standards and prohibited advertising categories, which are not restrictive covenants for purposes of this rule.
